sanityReview.result: NOT READY TO MERGE — three blockers

blockers.title: Automatic recovery falsely reported persistent occlusion
blockers.cause: paWaveformReturned folded forcedSafetyRecovery into an observation about the tracing
blockers.fix: paWaveformReturned is an observation only; occlusionReleasedByLearner carries the release provenance; whyNotReturned no longer cites the release; either answer notes an automatic release without crediting a deflation
blockers.preserved: automatic cutoff behaviour; balloon-down goal still refuses credit for an automatic release; authored stop/escalate guidance still shown where the trace truly has not returned; R8 hold untouched; no invented distance or complication

blockers.title: A stale answer claimed a new observation was recorded
blockers.cause: the ReturnCheck answer was React state that outlived the occlusion episode
blockers.fix: the answer is stored with its episode and shown only when that episode is current, derived from the existing paReturnEpisodeKey; "Recorded for this occlusion" additionally requires the engine to have accepted the check for that episode
blockers.preserved: the engine-level episode check from batch 01 is unchanged

blockers.title: The displayed-pressure projection did not snapshot the monitor
blockers.cause: the provenance adapter read state.measurements while calling the value displayed; capstoneState(808) at +8 s showed 69 on the monitor and 68 in the record
blockers.fix: monitorPressureReadouts is the single implementation of the rail arterial and central-venous numbers and their rounding; the monitor and the record both read it; the record names the sampling window
blockers.preserved: no physiology changed; the model-versus-trace difference itself is untouched; Task-02 scope not entered
